$comment: The source of sf-switch's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/switch, generated by migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs from simai/ui-source@5100227 src/smart/switch/smart.manifest.json (stand 17's conversion control/smart-architecture/stands/17-ports-migration/out/switch.component.json); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. x-todo lists what a person decides.

short.summary: A shorter track, one and a half times its height instead of two, for a tight row. The class sf-switch--short of the class markup, as a setting.

help.summary: The explanation behind a «?» button (sf-help-mark) after the label text; a press on the button opens it and never changes the control. The help slot takes an sf-help-mark of the page's own.

value.summary: What a checked switch submits; without it, "on", as a native checkbox (simai/ui-source#38).

change.summary: The on state changed; the native event bubbles from the inner checkbox, which is its target.

field-reset.summary: The person pressed the reset back to the inherited value. The event of the trait field-inherit@1: one name for every field of the family, so a form hears them all at once and tells them apart by detail.tag. Fired before the field is emptied and cancellable: preventDefault keeps the value. When it is not prevented the field empties, says so with its ordinary change, shows the inherited value again and takes focus back.

tag.summary: The element that was reset, as a tag name.

value.summary: The field's own value before the reset.

inherited-value.summary: The inherited value it returns to.

name.summary: The form name, empty when the field has none.

aliases.$comment: Dated aliases of sf-switch for the shim (stands/18-aliases-ci/alias.mjs, standard §16 item 20). mode: same-detail (the shim sends the new and the old name), split / detail-adds (a detail adapter, refused by the shim), attribute-and-property, method, property, manifest-only (the DOM name does not change), host-attribute (no shim), retired.

rows.note: the event of the trait field-inherit@1, declared in component.json as the shared event field-reset; the field sends sf-field-reset and the shim follows it with this dated name, same detail, one cancel
rows.summary: The person pressed the reset back to the inherited value. Fired before the field is emptied and cancellable: preventDefault keeps the value. When it is not prevented the field empties, says so with its ordinary change, shows the inherited value again and takes focus back.

rows.note: stays a host attribute, read by the base (§3.1, §4.8); no shim

x-summary: An on/off control for a setting that applies at once: a native checkbox with role="switch", a track and a moving thumb, with a label, description and help text.
x-renamed: settings.aria-label: a host attribute, read by the base, never a setting (§3.1)

x-todo.what: the shared field words (INHERITED_TEXT) belong to a trait; where a trait's words live is an open question
the markup is drawn in JavaScript: write template.html (and the named templates) from it
examples.json from the Studio fixtures (studio.fixture.json, studio.scenario.json)

x-decisions: version 1.3.1: the name is the label alone, the description is the description (standard 1.3.8 §4.8, simai/ui-source#44 item 1). The label, the description, the inherited marker and the reset all sit inside one <label>, so a press anywhere flips the switch -- and the label named the checkbox by all of its text. The binding (component/switch/js/_switch.js, linkSwitchText) now names the checkbox by the label row (aria-labelledby) and describes it by the description (aria-describedby), for the element, its slots and the class markup alike; an author's aria-label or aria-labelledby wins and ids already on aria-describedby are kept. The ids come from the instance path (§7.1.1), never a counter. A browser reads aria-describedby instead of aria-description, so while the inherited state applies the inherited sentence is a hidden note that aria-describedby names as well. Nothing is drawn differently.

version 1.3.2: the hidden inherited note is the family's, written once in helpers/inherited-value.js (syncInheritedNote) rather than here; the switch reads the same, its note is [data-sf-inherited-note] with the same id.

version 1.3.3 (2026-11-08): a patch, nothing drawn differently by this element. Its shared helper src/smart/helpers/inherited-value.js changed with the actions block (module.smart-helpers 1.3.0). Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.3.4 (2026-11-09): a patch; nothing in the component changed. A shared sheet it draws with moved in the next block (src/smart/helpers/inherited-value.css, the C27 inherited-value reset), so the component takes a patch with it.

version 1.4.0 (2026-11-11): a new setting `short` draws the shorter track (one and a half heights), which a page could reach only by root-class="sf-switch--short" (docs pre-check 2026-11-10 SW-06); the class stays the class markup's and root-class keeps working. An on switch is one primary pill: its edge takes the fill colour instead of the outline (component.switch, SW-05). Also in 1.4.0: the help setting is the explanation, not an icon name (audit 2026-11-11, W1): it draws an sf-help-mark after the label text (size 1/3 beside sizes 1/2 and 1, 1/2 beside size 2; its button named «Подробнее: <label>», word runtime.help), the help slot keeps taking content of its own; it was a decorative aria-hidden icon inside the <label>, so no help existed and a press on it toggled the control. A press that comes from the help (sf-help-mark or what the help slot holds) cancels the label's activation (keepHelpOutOfLabel in src/component/checkable-text-helper.js), the mark stands above the native control's hit area, and pressing it paints no pressed box. The input is named by the label text alone, so the help button's name is not part of it. (the switch was named by its label text already). No position setting: the Smart page never promised one; the class markup puts the track at the end by its order. The help change is a minor by itself (§4.10; journal behaviour-choice-help-text): 1.4.0 carries it. Also in 1.4.0 (owner remarks 2026-11-11, C59): the help mark is the <label>'s sibling, not inside it: with help the element draws a row (.sf-checkable-row) that holds the <label> and the mark after it, --sf-space-1/4 after the label, centred on the first line, never wrapping alone; pressing «?» presses no control. The hit area is the track and its text: the element's own <label> hugs its content (inline-size: fit-content; max-inline-size: 100%); class markup in C49 rows keeps its full width (component.switch 1.3.0). The name and the description are unchanged. C63 (owner 2026-11-11, audit W5, W6, W9), in the same release: W5, a control with text is a row of its step, (control height - line) / 2 above and below on its own <label>, no gap of its own: 40 at size 1, 60 with a description line, 32 in compact, and under a coarse pointer the step is the touch target max(step, --sf-d1) as the C49 rows; a bare box (no label, no description) stays the box. W6, the label is regular in all three (checkbox and radio drew medium). W9, one shared base: src/smart/helpers/checkable-row.js and checkable-row.css (module.smart-helpers 1.5.0) draw the text column with its help slot, the help mark, the row (.sf-checkable-row) and hold the row's padding, the hit area, the help size and place for the three; the name and description binding is src/component/checkable-text-helper.js for all three (sf-switch had its own copy). The control's <label> carries .sf-checkable, .sf-checkable--size-<size> and, with text, .sf-checkable--text. Journal behaviour-choice-row-step. W7 (owner decision C66, variant 1), in the same release, through component.switch 1.3.0: a press paints no on look (the track filled primary while the thumb waited for the release); after the release the track, thumb and edge colours and the thumb travel run together on one clock, 200 ms on --sf-ease-move (calc(var(--sf-duration-fast) * 2): the scale has no 200 ms step; was 300 ms on --sf-animation); an on switch keeps its edge the fill colour on hover too, no ring; reduced motion 0.

version 1.5.0, also (2026-11-12, fix/choice-controls-w; the integration carries this switch as 1.5.0): with help and text, the «?» stands right after the name (C59, intent acceptance of the group build 2026-11-12): beside the name's line when the description is longer than the name. The shared row (module.smart-helpers 1.6.0, checkable-row.css) is a grid there; the <label> and its text column hand their parts to it (display: contents) and the label's ::before keeps the hit area the control and its text. The markup, the name, the description and the row heights are unchanged; the «?» stays outside the label.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-switch when a binary setting takes effect immediately and may need supporting text.
do_not: Do not use Switch for a value submitted only after a separate confirmation action
Do not label it with commands such as Enable and Disable
Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component

accessibility.focus: Keep visible focus on the active control. After a reset back to the inherited value, focus returns to the control; while the value is inherited, the control carries it as aria-description and the visible marker is aria-hidden.

sf-field:reset.summary: The person pressed the reset back to the inherited value. Fired before the field is emptied and cancellable: preventDefault keeps the value. When it is not prevented the field empties, says so with its ordinary change, shows the inherited value again and takes focus back.

value.description: The field's own value before the reset.

inheritedValue.description: The inherited value it returns to.

name.description: The form name, empty when the field has none.

getInputElement.summary: Returns the inner native input (.sf-switch input[type="checkbox"]), or null before render.

setChecked.summary: Sets the checked property and state of the inner input; does not dispatch change.

setDisabled.summary: Sets or clears disabled on the host and the inner input.

setState.summary: Applies checked and disabled to the inner input and reflects them to host attributes; before render it falls back to the base setState.

onChange.summary: Adds a listener for the native change event that bubbles from the inner input.

onFocus.summary: Adds a focusin listener on the host.

onBlur.summary: Adds a focusout listener on the host.

resetToInherited.summary: Returns the field to its inherited value, as the reset button does: fires the cancellable sf-field-reset, then empties the own value and focuses the control. Returns whether it was reset (false without an inherited value, without an own value, while disabled or readonly, or when the event was prevented).

aria-label.description: Accessible name for a switch rendered without a visible label, as in a record panel that draws the label itself.

inherited-value.description: Whether the switch is on while it holds no value of its own: true/on or false/off. The knob stands where it says, quieter, with an «inherited» marker, and the checkbox submits nothing. With it set, «off» chosen by a person is kept as checked="false" -- a value of its own -- and no `checked` at all means the inherited state; a reset button returns there.

inherited-text.description: The words of the marker shown while the inherited value applies. Unset, it follows the page's language («inherited», «наследуется»).

reset-label.description: The accessible name of the button that returns the field to the inherited value. Unset, it follows the page's language («Reset to inherited», «Сбросить к наследуемому»).
